# Range Calendar

Choose an inclusive date range directly in an always-visible calendar grid.

## Usage

### Booking

Choose an inclusive start and end date for a reservation.

<ComponentExample component="range-calendar" scenario="booking" title="Booking" description="Choose an inclusive start and end date for a reservation." :index="0" />

### Bounded

Reject values outside the configured minimum and maximum.

<ComponentExample component="range-calendar" scenario="bounded" title="Bounded" description="Reject values outside the configured minimum and maximum." :index="1" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

<ComponentExample component="range-calendar" scenario="controlled" title="Controlled" description="Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component." :index="2" />

## Style available and selected dates

Style availability and selection from the public ARIA state on calendar cells. You do not need a second visual-only list that can drift from the component policies.

```css
[data-scope='range-calendar'][data-part='cell'][aria-selected='true'] {
  background: CanvasText;
  color: Canvas;
}

[data-scope='range-calendar'][data-part='cell'][aria-disabled='true'] {
  opacity: .45;
  text-decoration: line-through;
}
```

For SSR or tests that need a stable initial month, set the API `referenceDate` so the first rendered view does not depend on the current clock.

## API reference

See [Range Calendar API](/api/components/range-calendar) for props, events, slots, public types, part selectors, and keyboard behavior.

## Accessibility

The always-visible grid exposes both range endpoints and every date between them without a popup trigger.
